metadata.description: Live-captured with tools/mock-capture --allow-error-status against UEM 26.2 on 2026-09-24, inside a disposable sdktestrun org group, on an object deleted moments earlier (the org group was deleted afterwards and a second DELETE on it returned 400, quirk 20). Status, errorCode and message are verbatim except that the real resource id (in the path and the message) is replaced by a fixed id chosen to be unique in this corpus; the activityId is the capture anonymizer's output. Second DELETE /api/mdm/profiles/{profileId} on an already-deleted profile: 400, errorCode 400, 'Profile not found or User does not have access to the Profile.'. Differs from the GET wording. The request was sent with Accept version=2 (recorded as metadata.version and request.headers), but the response's X-Api-Version header said v1: this route is registered only at v1, and the server serves a higher requested version with its highest registered one (api-doctrine quirk 1). The SDK's generated DELETE now sends version=1. client.IsNotFound matches the message prefix so Terraform Delete can treat already-gone as success.

body.message: Profile not found or User does not have access to the Profile.
